title: 第11章 怀璧其罪第12章 交出丹药
content_zh:
“哈哈哈，你这废物有钱买五十枚淬体丹？秦浩，你该不会得了妄想症，疯了吧！”
“就是，你以为淬体丹是大白菜吗？”
陈江和陈林山先是愣了下，旋即捂着肚子疯狂大笑，仿佛听到了什么天大的笑话。
不少人看向秦浩的目光，也露出了讥讽之色。
一名风度翩翩的少年缓步走来，眉宇之间，和柳若雪有几分相似，他淡笑道：“秦浩，我知道检测出一品武魂对你打击很大，但就算做梦也要在晚上，大白天在这里说梦话，秦家的脸都让你丢尽了。”
“呵呵，你要是能买得起五十枚淬体丹，我名字倒着写！”
秦浩转头瞥了少年一眼，眼中冷意一闪。
这少年名叫柳若杰，正是柳若雪的弟弟。
而且，柳若杰身后还站着几个柳家子弟，此刻，俱是面露嘲讽的看着秦浩。
“是吗？那你记住，以后名字都倒着写吧！”
秦浩掏出十张银票，每一张都是万两，随意的放在柜台上。
听到秦浩的话，柳若杰先是脸色一沉，随即看到十张银票，顿时瞪大了眼睛。
“什么？十万两银票！”
“嘶！
秦浩这废物，居然有十万两银票！”
“淬体丹二千两一枚，五十枚淬体丹，正好十万两！
这个废物，竟然真的买得起五十枚淬体丹！”
大厅内，一片倒吸气声。
众人满脸震惊，可下一秒，一个个俱是露出贪婪之色。
陈江和陈林山更是双眸瞪得滚圆，呼吸急促，恨不得立即将秦浩手中的十张银票抢走。

他们一个月的月例，也不过几十、上百两银子。
想要攒足十万两，不知道猴年马月。
“不可能，秦浩，你只是一品武魂的废物，秦家不可能拿这么多银两给你买丹药，一定是你偷的，对，肯定是你偷来的！”
柳若杰脸颊抽动，仿佛被人狠狠扇了一巴掌。
秦浩冷笑的看了眼柳若杰，懒得理他，转而将手上提着的包裹放在柜台上，说道：“顺便给我把这些折算成淬体丹。”
这个包裹里面装的，正是妖兽材料。
许多武者前往墨林山脉猎杀妖兽，便是为了收集妖兽材料，然后出售换取丹药修炼。
秦浩不敢肯定五十枚淬体丹够不够冲击三品武魂，保险起见，把这些妖兽材料也卖了。
少女店员愣了下，说道：“好的，公子请稍等。”
小片刻后，少女店员急急忙忙的拿着一个木盒子走了过来，眉宇之间满是兴奋，这么大笔买卖，她的提成可不少呢。
“公子，这里一共五十八枚淬体丹。”
“您的材料折算成淬体丹一共五枚，外加您要购买的五十枚，一共五十五枚。”
少女说道：“因为您的交易金额比较大，我们珍宝阁格外赠送三枚淬体丹，预祝公子万象天才战旗开得胜，勇争第一！”
此话一出，整个大厅内又是一片倒吸气声。
不仅陈江和陈山林等人，即便不少来此交易的高阶淬体境武者，亦是毫不掩饰心中的贪婪。
“好的，借你吉言。”
秦浩微微一笑。
“公子请慢走。”
少女弯腰甜甜说道。
秦浩点点头，提着木盒子便往珍宝阁外走去。
content_en:
"Hahaha, you loser has money to buy fifty body tempering pills? Qin Hao, are you suffering from paranoia? Are you crazy?"
"That's right, do you think the Body Tempering Pill is Chinese cabbage?"
Chen Jiang and Chen Linshan were stunned for a moment, then held their stomachs and laughed wildly, as if they had heard some big joke.
Many people looked at Qin Hao with sarcasm.
A handsome young man walked slowly over. His brows were somewhat similar to Liu Ruoxue's. He smiled lightly and said, "Qin Hao, I know that the detection of a first-grade martial spirit will be a big blow to you, but even if you dream, you have to do it at night. If you talk in your sleep here in broad daylight, you will be embarrassed by the Qin family."
"Haha, if you can afford fifty body tempering pills, I'll write my name backwards!"
Qin Hao turned his head and glanced at the young man, with a cold look in his eyes.
This young man's name is Liu Ruojie, and he is Liu Ruoxue's younger brother.
Moreover, there were several Liu family members standing behind Liu Ruojie. At this moment, they were all looking at Qin Hao with mocking expressions.
"Really? Then remember, write your names backwards from now on!"
Qin Hao took out ten banknotes, each worth ten thousand taels, and placed them casually on the counter.
After hearing Qin Hao's words, Liu Ruojie's face darkened at first, and then his eyes widened when he saw ten banknotes.
"What? One hundred thousand taels of silver!"
"Hiss!
Qin Hao, this loser, actually has one hundred thousand taels of silver notes! "
"Two thousand taels of Body Tempering Pills, fifty Body Tempering Pills, exactly one hundred thousand taels!
This trash can actually afford fifty Body Tempering Pills! "
There was a gasp in the hall.
Everyone was shocked, but in the next second, everyone showed greed.
Chen Jiang and Chen Linshan's eyes were widened, their breathing was rapid, and they wanted to snatch the ten silver notes from Qin Hao's hand immediately.
Their monthly income is only tens or hundreds of taels of silver.
If you want to save a hundred thousand taels, you don’t know the year of the monkey and the month of the horse.
"Impossible, Qin Hao, you are just a waste of a first-grade martial spirit. It is impossible for the Qin family to buy you the elixir with so much silver. You must have stolen it, yes, you must have stolen it!"
Liu Ruojie's cheek twitched, as if he had been slapped hard.
Qin Hao glanced at Liu Ruojie with a sneer and was too lazy to pay attention to him. Instead, he put the package he was carrying on the counter and said, "By the way, convert these into body tempering pills for me."
This package contains exactly the materials of monster beasts.
Many warriors go to the Merlin Mountains to hunt monsters in order to collect monster materials and then sell them in exchange for elixirs for cultivation.
Qin Hao was not sure whether fifty body tempering pills were enough to attack the third-grade martial soul, so he sold these monster materials to be on the safe side.
The girl clerk was stunned for a moment and said, "Okay, sir, please wait a moment."
After a short while, the girl clerk hurriedly came over with a wooden box, her brows full of excitement. She would get a lot of commission from such a large transaction.
"Sir, there are a total of fifty-eight Body Tempering Pills here."
"Your materials are converted into five Body Tempering Pills, plus the fifty you want to buy, for a total of fifty-five."
The girl said: "Because your transaction amount is relatively large, our Zhenbao Pavilion will give you three Body Tempering Pills as a gift. I wish the young master Wanxiang Genius to win the battle and strive for the first place!"
As soon as these words came out, there was another gasp in the entire hall.
Not only Chen Jiang and Chen Shanlin, but also many high-level Body Tempering Realm warriors who came here to trade did not hide their greed.
"Okay, let me lend you some good words."
Qin Hao smiled slightly.
"Master, please go slowly."
The girl bent down and said sweetly.
Qin Hao nodded and walked out of the Treasure Pavilion carrying the wooden box.
